prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce exactly ONE clear high-fidelity Simplified Chinese desktop DooKnow settings-page design for an authenticated owner, straight-on full application canvas around 1536×1024, no browser/device frame, no external title/caption.
INPUT AUTHORITY: Image 1 is this exact running pre-redesign settings baseline, authoritative for existing content, controls, navigation, permissions and selected state. Image 2 PILOT-WS-001 is ONLY the approved DooKnow palette, typography/density and rail/header hierarchy reference. Do not import its notebook tree, empty-note content or note toolbar. Real source templates override generic API summaries.
Shared shell: full-height approximately 64px muted gray owner rail at far left, account avatar O at top; real destinations 笔记, 最近, 收藏, separator, 应用; bottom 回收站 and 设置, with 设置 active. Full 56px global header to the right of owner rail: existing blue open-book logo and exact DooKnow wordmark, divider, static context 设置. No invented header actions, counts or notifications. Below header use a light-gray contextual settings sidebar with 返回笔记 and exactly eight destinations in order: 通用与编辑, 知识库与存储, 搜索与索引, 备份与恢复, 后台状态, 插件与连接, 账号与安全, 关于与诊断; select only current destination. Main content is white, flexible max approximately 1000px, aligned card edges/fields and readable compact desktop text. Preserve existing page eyebrow 设置, page title, description and top-right 返回笔记.
Style: flat white #ffffff surfaces and #f7f8fa rail/sidebar, text #272b3a secondary #657084, thin #e6e9f1 separators, blue #4566c6 primary actions and #edf1ff selected rows, restrained 8px radii, no gradients/textures/heavy shadows. Preserve exact controls and their enabled/disabled state. Legible Chinese and clear spacing matter more than decorative polish.
Hard invariants: one coherent actual baseline state; do not combine mutually exclusive overlays or states. No ToDoo brand, tasks, calendars, habits, teams, members, AI chat, new features or invented navigation. No protocol metadata fields (requestId, versions, hash, cursor, nonce, CSRF), no developer/contract captions inside UI, no new fake connected/online/success states. Secrets masked, server paths /srv/example only if actually expanded. Static concept does not prove runtime/interaction/responsiveness.
PAGE-SPECIFIC CONTENT:
CURRENT PAGE 通用与编辑. Description exact 设置当前设备上的阅读与编辑习惯。 Recreate baseline coherent saved preferences state. Main 编辑与阅读 section exact explanation 设置保存在当前账户的这台浏览器中。保存后用于笔记显示，原文格式保持不变。 Toolbar 保存偏好 blue, 取消更改 DISABLED, 恢复默认设置 neutral; status 当前偏好已保存. Fields in this exact order: 默认打开方式 select 编辑 and helper 新打开笔记时使用的视图。; 自动换行 switch ON with helper Markdown 源码中的长段落随编辑区域宽度换行。; 显示行号 switch OFF with helper 在 Markdown 源码中显示行号，便于定位原文段落。; 文字大小 select 15 px; 阅读宽度 select 舒适; 外观 select 浅色. Source documentEditingEnabled is false in this selected baseline, so 默认编辑方式 MUST STAY HIDDEN. At bottom retain collapsed 显示预览 disclosure. Separate existing 键盘操作 action card, description 查看常用快捷键，让编辑和浏览更顺手。 and button 查看快捷键. All content including keyboard card is visible with ample clear text, main save action accessible. Do not expand preview or show keyboard dialog.
generationInstruction: Style-only unification of one coherent actual baseline settings page. Use actual matching screenshot as content/role/navigation authority and PILOT-WS001 only as muted palette, compact 64px owner rail / global header hierarchy, flat surfaces and aligned fields/toolbar. Preserve settings context labels, currently visible fields, busy/read-only/connection state and existing buttons. Source-hidden fields stay hidden in this selected flag/baseline; other conditions mapped in state matrices. No transfer of note tree into settings, ToDoo logo/text, invented notifications/actions/features, fake connected states or protocol fields. Real template source outranks generic API field summaries. MP-D001 通用与编辑

1440 CSS px桌面宿主；主页面/密集表单独立且可延长纵向画布以保留完整字段。窗口按源码宽度约束，板外画布可扩大而不缩成缩略图。

角色壳：所有者私有管理；只用平台真实主导航与8项设置二级菜单/实际插件宿主，不借ToDoo业务菜单。

明确独立场景：
A | ST-001 | 通用与编辑 | role=authenticated-owner | state=实际baseline原状态/隔离示例的完整主布局；其他互斥状态另列设计板

完整构图：
完整设置页：8项真实设置二级菜单；默认编辑方式（开关允许时）、默认打开方式、换行、行号、字号、阅读宽度、外观、显示示意和保存/取消/默认/快捷键。document禁止split。

精确字段/操作/权限合同（API元数据不画成输入）：
ST-001权限：管理API要求已登录所有者；除独立/auth处理路径外，/api写请求须同源Origin及x-csrf-token；维护模式503（apps/server/app.ts:141）。
ST-001真实可见字段顺序：默认编辑方式 [select; 可选]: document/source；仅documentEditingEnabled时显示 | 默认打开方式 [select; 可选]: edit/preview/split；文档编辑禁用split | 自动换行 [switch; 可选]: 既有控件 | 显示行号 [switch; 可选]: 既有控件 | 文字大小 [select; 可选]: 14/15/16/18/20px | 阅读宽度 [select; 可选]: comfortable/wide/full | 外观 [select; 可选]: system/light/dark
ST-001动作白名单：保存偏好 => 写入当前账户当前浏览器偏好；通知笔记显示更新；guard=本地偏好，无服务器写入
ST-001动作白名单：取消更改 => 载入已保存偏好；guard=dirty
ST-001动作白名单：恢复默认设置 => 只载入预览，保存后生效；guard=无额外确认
ST-001动作白名单：查看快捷键 => 打开ST-009；guard=已登录所有者；请求期间禁用重复操作

响应式合同：
1000px最大内容宽度；窄屏缩小内边距、操作区换行；≤600px返回按钮短标签；≤430px非开关偏好行纵排。源码支持，未运行浏览器验证。
390/320目标：label/错误/长URL路径换行；表格代码仅内层滚动，无页面横向溢出；窗口限高正文滚动/页脚可达，focus可见。SettingsOverlay与PluginPanel各自真实busy/dirty关闭差异不可混用；公开/登录/首启/OAuth无主人私有栏。

硬性禁止：
ToDoo仅是style-only：提取真实两级层级、浅灰侧栏/白底、蓝色主动作、细线、小圆角、字体/间距/密度，禁止复制任务/日历/专注/习惯内容和菜单。DooKnow保留实际模块品牌。
不新增团队/成员/组织、AI聊天、社交登录、浏览器注册/找回密码或分享密码门。
协议元数据requestId、expectedVersion/expectedModifiedAt、hash、opaque cursor、nonce、CSRF只是不可见guard，不画成输入；仅fields中的真实UI控件可编辑，API清单放设计审查注解而非产品。
所有秘密只用掩码或<token>/<private-key>；服务器位置仅用/srv/example占位；不显示真实凭据/原文/私有目录。
本地保存、Git提交、远端push、加密备份、博客发布/启用独立；不硬编码成功数量、在线状态或业务返回。
多面板是明确外部标注DESIGN BOARD的独立场景，最多3面板；绝不假装互斥窗口同时打开。

内容参考：匹配真实baseline时沿用knowledge/Asia/Shanghai，公开夹具“隔离示例手记”“示例作者”“让知识保持可用”“记录与回顾”；博客已保存accent #44684f与journal/magazine/profile差异保留。未捕获状态只用明确合成示例，数量/成功/客户端状态不成为固定业务结果。登录空占位、秘密掩码，禁止照搬ToDoo任务内容。

状态编号/说明放产品画面外。仅fields是真实可见输入；requestId/version/hash/cursor/nonce/CSRF等只作后台guard。输出不是实测通过或审批；逐图功能/权限/响应式审查与全局审查完成前不得开发。
